common_budget_semantics.fairness_basis: same common objective evaluation cap, while internal termination remains optimizer-specific

effective_scope: R23 Experiment B2 only; 3 frozen n=4 instances x p=2,3 x fixed_0.1; no other experiment or optimizer.

frozen_scipy.both_budgets_unset_policy: N*200; not applicable because maxiter and maxfev are explicitly set by this amendment.

implementation_gate_review.current_state: Nelder-Mead is supported by the frozen implementation authority and targeted validation; historical COBYLA-only wording is retained as provenance and does not override current implementation evidence.
implementation_gate_review.historical_wording: Current R23 qaoa.py/schema.py accept COBYLA only. B2 requires a new optimizer adapter/schema path, preserved source hashes, separate smoke validation, and result metadata capture before authority build.

reason: Resolve the B2 authorization block by explicitly freezing the frozen-environment Nelder-Mead defaults already used by the adapter, without tuning.
scientific_rationale: Use the frozen SciPy 1.17.1 defaults explicitly so B2 isolates optimizer choice and adds no performance tuning degree of freedom.

termination_semantics.convergence: SciPy Nelder-Mead convergence requires both simplex x spread <= xatol and function spread <= fatol.
termination_semantics.external_cap: The project objective callback refuses a call once 900 objective evaluations have occurred; this remains the common research cap.
termination_semantics.maxfev: Explicitly 900, aligned with the project common objective evaluation cap; SciPy stops at the first reached limit.
termination_semantics.maxiter: Nelder-Mead iteration limit; 300, optimizer-specific and not equivalent workload across optimizers.
termination_semantics.wall_time: No research wall-time stop; wall time is a measurement outcome.

tuning_statement: No tolerance search, benchmark, pilot, adaptive selection, or parameter tuning was performed.
